profile.about:
I’m Snaker — a designer and video editor who cares about the details people feel but rarely notice: spacing, rhythm, timing, contrast.

From brand identities and social content to full video edits and motion graphics, I build work that’s clear, modern and made to be remembered. Edit this text from the admin panel.
